emerging_technology: Agentic AI: a language model dynamically chooses tools, observes results and adjusts bounded multi-step work, with limited permissions and human stopping authority. The integrated system, not all generative AI or fixed automation, is the innovation under analysis.
intended_application: Human-supervised chart-to-source-table review. Read-only tools compare charts and claims against approved tables, then draft source-linked corrections for a named human reviewer; no autonomous publication or financial/customer decisions.
organization: Hypothetical mid-sized United States financial-services firm
industry_sector: Financial services and internal management reporting
business_need: Determine whether chart-review quality and complete effort improve over manual review and simpler deterministic checks.
users_stakeholders: Reporting analysts, report owners, BI support, security, compliance and managers consuming reports.
adoption_posture: Aggressive but controlled learning posture. Prefer earlier low-cost reversible feasibility learning, while gathering peer evidence in parallel; data permissions, safeguards and acceptable business consequences are unchanged.
capabilities_constraints: No model/tool environment or data-transfer path is authorized, even for a public/synthetic exercise. A written security decision is required before any agent activity. Manual and deterministic review remain available; no local quality/cost evidence is supplied. The only change from posture_contrast is removal of learning permission.
risk_consequence_context: Disclosure of sensitive records or incorrect charts can have material consequences. Public/synthetic offline drafts are reversible. A human must validate source-linked findings before any report is released.
management_question: Which single adoption posture is justified for this application in this organization now, and what evidence or changed condition should trigger a different action?
time_horizon: A decision now, an evidence review within 21 days, and a possible two-week PoC only within its stated permission and cap. No actual deployment deadline.
additional_context:
Teaching case, not a real firm, real permission or observed pilot. Continuity: the prior Lab5/TW6 chart-review proposal had no approved sensitive-data environment and no local advantage/peer diffusion measurement. NEW Lab6 teaching premise K0: management permits only an offline read-only public/synthetic-data feasibility exercise, capped at eight analyst-hours over two weeks. This is not an approved internal-data sandbox, production integration or organizational readiness attestation. Manual and deterministic checks are available; no local agent benchmark has been run. The conservative case prefers matched peer and baseline evidence before starting an agent exercise. This preference is changed only by adoption_posture in the contrast.
